purpose: Remove ambiguity between event-transform operators and Boolean context gates without changing the V209 frozen universe.

STRUCTURAL_STATE: EMA/ATR/indicator state from causally available completed bars

candidate_consumption.rule: A completed breakout candidate, or completed retest candidate when RETEST_ENTRY is active, consumes that candidate opportunity even if a Boolean gate fails. A failed filter may not wait on the already-broken/reclaimed level until a later favorable indicator state without a valid rearm event.
candidate_consumption.reason: Prevents hidden time-search/optional stopping inside one confirmed level.

retest.boundary_replaced_while_pending: cancel pending retest and rebuild from new confirmed boundary
retest.filter_snapshot_time: reclaim completion time, not original breakout time, except structural facts explicitly frozen at breakout remain frozen

tick_break.indicator_state: last completed signal bar strictly available before triggering quote
tick_break.session_gate: candidate quote timestamp mapped through frozen Darwinex clock/session contract
tick_break.multi_tf: latest fully closed mapped context bar strictly available before triggering quote

close_break.indicator_state: may include the just-completed signal bar that establishes close break
close_break.session_gate: completed bar signal timestamp mapped through frozen Darwinex clock/session contract
close_break.fill: next executable quote after completed-bar signal availability

event_identity.signal_event_id: candidate_event_id when all active gates pass; filtered candidates remain auditable but are not trades

event_mask.definition: ordered set/bitset of signal_event_id positions on the canonical DEV event axis for one SIGNAL_CONFIG_ID
event_mask.dedupe: exact equality of canonical event masks only; no similarity clustering before Gate A
event_mask.zero_event_mask: valid retained class; may alias other zero-event configurations but is not silently discarded

invariants: no filter may alter already frozen configuration domains
event-transform families are not evaluated as ordinary post-hoc Boolean masks
Boolean gate order is commutative only after all gate inputs are snapshotted at the same final candidate event
same-day execution remains downstream and does not change GA1 event membership
